children: REG-SAMPO BOOKS AN IMPAIRMENT LOSS ON INTANGIBLE ASSETS RELATED TO ITS IT SYSTEMS IN DENMARK
WILL RECOGNISE AN IMPAIRMENT LOSS WITH RELATED VAT CHARGES, TOTALING TO APPROXIMATELY EUR 118 MILLION BEFORE TAX FOR Q3 OF 2026
EFFECT ON SOLVENCY IS EXPECTED TO BE MINOR.
NON-CASH LOSS WILL BE RECOGNISED IN OTHER EXPENSES, AND IT WILL BE EXCLUDED FROM OPERATING EPS
